summary: iter17 — Env-driven subscription pricing + Telegram teacher notify on timetable save + Suggest constraints (lunch / no-last-period / day-pins). BACKEND: 13/13 NEW pytest cases PASS in 3.12s (test_iter17_pricing_notify_constraints.py) AND 14/14 REGRESSION cases PASS in 2.13s (test_suggest_timetable.py). Verified end-to-end: (1) GET /api/subscriptions/pricing returns {30,300,30,365,INR} defaults; (2) /api/subscriptions/my quote.pricing.per_child_monthly/yearly/currency exactly match the /pricing endpoint, and monthly.rate_per_child == per_child_monthly, yearly.rate_per_child == per_child_yearly; (3) suggest lunch_break_period=3 with periods_per_day=6 → total_slots=25 (not 30), every Period-3 slot has is_break=true, subject_id='', teacher_id=''; (4) lunch_break_period > periods_per_day → 400 with 'lunch' in detail (caught by route handler); (5) no_last_period_subjects=[Math] → Math excluded from last period when alternatives exist, or warning surfaces when forced; (6) subject_day_pins {Hindi:[mon,wed]} → ALL Hindi slots fall on Mon/Wed, NO relaxation warning when capacity sufficient (verified 5 Hindi slots × pinned to 2 days × 6 periods = cap 12 >> 5); (7) overrides combined with day-pins respected, sum overflow → 400; (8) RBAC: teacher 403, accounts 403, regression for both unchanged; (9) POST /timetable/bulk returns {inserted, notified_teachers} where notified_teachers = distinct teacher_ids (verified 1 teacher × 3 slots → notified_teachers=1, dedup works); (10) empty slots POST returns {inserted:0, notified_teachers:0} — no notify failure; (11) Telegram failure path wrapped in try/except so save succeeds. FRONTEND (/school/classes as principal@sunrise.edu): SuggestTimetableModal advanced panel verified live — suggest-tt-toggle-advanced reveals suggest-tt-advanced; reveals suggest-tt-lunch dropdown, 5 suggest-tt-no-last-<sid> chips, 25 pin chips (5 subjects × 5 days). Set lunch=P3 + Regenerate → 5 Period-3 cells render with '🍽 Lunch' label and time range '10:30–11:15'. Warnings panel renders properly. Save handler in ClassesPage.jsx:740-754 correctly: (a) filters teachingSlots by teacher_id (excludes lunch is_break entries), (b) shows toast 'Timetable saved (<N> slots). <M> teacher(s) notified via Telegram.' when notified_teachers > 0.
critical_code_review_comments: subscriptions.py:35-52 env-getters _monthly_price/_yearly_price/_monthly_days/_yearly_days/_currency read int(os.environ.get(...)) at call-time → docker-compose / .env updates propagate without redeploy. Default fallbacks (30/300/30/365/INR) preserve legacy contract. Confirmed: same values appear in /pricing AND in /my.quote.pricing (per the env-getter being called in both _quote_for_school and /pricing).

timetable.py:14-58 _notify_teachers_of_timetable_change — wrapped in try/except in caller (line 84-91) so notify failures NEVER block the timetable save. queue_notification is invoked once per DISTINCT teacher_id (sorted set dedup at line 30) with own_periods computed via list comprehension — correct counting.

timetable.py:93 — endpoint returns notified = len({d['teacher_id'] for d in docs if d.get('teacher_id')}) which is correct: counts distinct teachers, excludes empty teacher_id slots and lunch (is_break) entries.
timetable.py:336-338 lunch validation — explicit 400 when lunch > periods_per_day. Pydantic le=12 catches absurd values (422). Combined safely covers both validation paths.

timetable.py:_compute_subject_counts — cap-aware iterative distribution respects day_pins capacity. When override exceeds cap, 'remaining > 0' fallback may push the override into other subjects' caps; if all caps full → raises 400 with 'restrictive' message. Tested with Hindi pinned to mon + override 20 → triggers the auto-balance failure path.

timetable.py:392-431 greedy assignment — 3-stage filter (day-pin → no-last-period → no-repeat-back-to-back) with graceful relaxation: warnings are surfaced (not hard-failed) when constraints conflict. Day-pin priority _pri puts pinned-on-current-day candidates first, avoiding wasted capacity (verified: Hindi[mon,wed] consumed perfectly without warnings).

timetable.py:444-458 lunch slot rendering — emits is_break=true + break_label='Lunch' + empty subject_id/teacher_id, with start/end times in 24h. Frontend ClassesPage.jsx:740 filters payloadSlots by teacher_id which correctly excludes break entries on save → GET /timetable returns 0 break slots (verified by code path).

ClassesPage.jsx:747-750 — toast composes ` ${data.notified_teachers} teacher(s) notified via Telegram.` ONLY when notified_teachers > 0; clean fallback to plain 'Timetable saved (N slots).' for unstaffed schedules.

Minor: ClassesPage.jsx pin chip testids use ${s.id} not subject code — testid format is suggest-tt-pin-<sid>-<d> where d is 3-letter lowercase day. Verified live (25 elements rendered for 5 subjects × 5 weekdays).

Edge case: lunch period dropdown maxes at periods_per_day — if user lowers periods_per_day AFTER selecting a lunch P > new max, backend still catches via the 400 in /suggest (route-level validation). Pydantic le=12 catches absurd UI inputs.
